changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Include native Fineract postings without imported office dimensions in the trial balance.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id, office_under.external_id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' AND office_under.external_id IS NOT NULL ), selected_accounts AS ( SELECT account.id AS report_account_id, account.gl_code AS source_gl_code, account.name AS source_name, CASE account.classification_enum WHEN 1 THEN '001' WHEN 2 THEN '002' WHEN 3 THEN '003' WHEN 5 THEN '004' WHEN 4 THEN '005' WHEN 6 THEN '007' END AS classifier_code, CASE account.classification_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'ACTIVO' WHEN 2 THEN 'PASIVO' WHEN 3 THEN 'CAPITAL' WHEN 5 THEN 'RESULTADO DEUDORAS' WHEN 4 THEN 'RESULTADO ACREEDORAS' WHEN 6 THEN 'CUENTAS DE ORDEN DEUDORAS' END AS classifier_name, CASE WHEN account.classification_enum IN (1, 5, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS trial_balance_group, CASE account.classification_enum WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 5 THEN 2 WHEN 6 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 4 WHEN 3 THEN 5 WHEN 4 THEN 6 END AS trial_balance_order, CASE WHEN account.classification_enum IN (1, 5) THEN 'D' ELSE 'A' END AS balance_nature, parent.id AS group_account_id, parent.gl_code AS group_code, parent.name AS group_name FROM acc_gl_account account JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = account.parent_id WHERE account.acc_level = 4 AND account.classification_enum IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) ), report_tree AS ( SELECT selected.report_account_id, selected.source_gl_code, selected.source_name, selected.classifier_code, selected.classifier_name, selected.trial_balance_group, selected.trial_balance_order, selected.balance_nature, selected.group_account_id, selected.group_code, selected.group_name, selected.report_account_id AS descendant_account_id, ARRAY[selected.report_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM selected_accounts selected
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.balance_nature, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM report_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.descendant_account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), component_balances AS ( SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN tree.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 2 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 1 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END END ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS balance FROM report_tree tree LEFT JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry ON journal_entry.account_id = tree.descendant_account_id AND journal_entry.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal_entry.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND ( jsonb_typeof(journal_entry.dimensions -> 'office') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM selected_offices office WHERE office.id = journal_entry.office_id AND office.external_id = journal_entry.dimensions ->> 'office' ) ) GROUP BY tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name ), visible_components AS ( SELECT * FROM component_balances WHERE balance <> 0.00 ), visible_groups AS ( SELECT classifier_code, classifier_name, trial_balance_group, trial_balance_order, group_account_id, group_code, group_name, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY classifier_code, classifier_name, trial_balance_group, trial_balance_order, group_account_id, group_code, group_name ), section_totals AS ( SELECT classifier_code, MIN(classifier_name) AS classifier_name, MIN(trial_balance_group) AS trial_balance_group, MIN(trial_balance_order) AS trial_balance_order, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY classifier_code ), side_totals AS ( SELECT trial_balance_group, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY trial_balance_group ), display_rows AS ( SELECT section.trial_balance_order AS section_order, 0 AS row_order, ''::VARCHAR AS group_code, ''::VARCHAR AS component_code, 'SECCION'::VARCHAR AS row_type, section.classifier_name AS section_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS group_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_code, section.classifier_name AS description, NULL::NUMERIC AS balance FROM section_totals section
UNION ALL
SELECT report_group.trial_balance_order, 1, report_group.group_code, '', 'GRUPO', report_group.classifier_name, report_group.group_name, report_group.group_code, report_group.group_name, report_group.balance FROM visible_groups report_group
UNION ALL
SELECT component.trial_balance_order, 2, component.group_code, component.source_gl_code, 'CUENTA', component.classifier_name, component.group_name, component.source_gl_code, component.source_name, component.balance FROM visible_components component
UNION ALL
SELECT section.trial_balance_order, 3, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_SECCION', section.classifier_name, NULL, NULL, CASE section.classifier_code WHEN '001' THEN 'TOTAL ACTIVO' WHEN '002' THEN 'TOTAL PASIVO' END, section.balance FROM section_totals section WHERE section.classifier_code IN ('001', '002')
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 4, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_INTERMEDIO', 'CAPITAL', NULL, NULL, 'TOTAL PASIVO, PATRIMONIO Y RESERVAS', SUM(balance) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code IN ('002', '003')) FROM section_totals
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE side.trial_balance_group WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 7 END, 9, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_BALANCE', NULL, NULL, NULL, CASE side.trial_balance_group WHEN 1 THEN 'TOTAL DE ACTIVO Y CUENTAS DEUDORAS' ELSE 'TOTALES' END, side.balance FROM side_totals side ), ordered_rows AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY section_order, CASE WHEN row_order IN (0, 3, 4, 9) THEN row_order ELSE 1 END, group_code COLLATE "C", row_order, component_code COLLATE "C" ) AS display_order, row_type, section_name, group_name, account_code, description, balance FROM display_rows ) SELECT display_order AS "Orden", row_type AS "Tipo Fila", section_name AS "Sección", group_name AS "Grupo", account_code AS "Cuenta", description AS "Descripción", balance AS "Saldo" FROM ordered_rows ORDER BY display_order $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Balance de Comprobación' AND report_subtype = 'VisualTrialBalance';
